per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should respond to routine navigations and small queries within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should support 350 concurrent users without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should be essentially always available, with scheduled maintenance windows.
The application should gate actions based on the user's role and entitlements, integrated with the identity and access management system.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should follow corporate UI standards for both internal and external-facing components.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Every action that affects case state or triggers an external request must be recorded in an audit trail.
The application should degrade gracefully when backend systems are unavailable, providing clear diagnostics and retry mechanisms.
The application should ensure data segregation so internal-only fields aren't exposed to merchants or cardmembers.
The application should use authoritative data from backend systems for core transaction attributes like amount and timestamps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application should facilitate compliance reviews without exposing unnecessary PII to reviewers.
